title: MSstatsBioNet Introduction
text: MSstatsBioNet package member MSstats family packages. contains set functions interpretation mass spectrometry (MS) statistical analysis results context protein-protein interaction networks. package designed used conjunction MSstats package.

title: MSstatsBioNet Introduction
text: taking subset dataset found paper.
code: input = data.table::fread(system.file(     "extdata/msstats.csv",     package = "MSstatsBioNet" ))

title: MSstatsBioNet Introduction
text: first convert input data format can processed MSstats. example, MetamorpheusToMSstatsFormat function used convert input data Metamorpheus MSstats format. text: Next, preprocess data using dataProcess function perform statistical analysis using groupComparison function. output groupComparison table containing list differentially abundant proteins associated p-values log fold changes.

title: MSstatsBioNet Introduction
text: package provides function getSubnetworkFromIndra retrieves subnetwork proteins INDRA database based differential abundance analysis results. package distributed Artistic-2.0 license. title: MSstatsBioNet Introduction
text: function previewNetworkInBrowser takes output getSubnetworkFromIndra visualizes subnetwork. function requires internet browser view subnetwork network diagram displayed using CytoscapeJS, see three arrows connecting two nodes, APP APOD. arrows represent interactions two proteins, notably Activation, IncreaseAmount (e.g. via transcriptional regulation), forming protein complex.
code: previewNetworkInBrowser(subnetwork$nodes, subnetwork$edges, displayLabelType = "hgncName")

text: install package bioconductor, run following command: can install development version package Github:

title: Network Analysis for MS-based Proteomics Experiments
text: examples help get started MSstatsBioNet:

title: Network Analysis for MS-based Proteomics Experiments
text: Use annotateProteinInfoFromIndra function annotate data frame protein information Indra.
code: library(MSstatsBioNet)  # Example data frame df <- data.frame(Protein = c("CLH1_HUMAN"))  # Annotate protein information annotated_df <- annotateProteinInfoFromIndra(df, "Uniprot_Mnemonic") print(head(annotated_df))

title: Network Analysis for MS-based Proteomics Experiments
text: Create interactive network diagram using cytoscapeNetwork.
code: # Define nodes and edges nodes <- data.frame(   id    = c("TP53", "MDM2", "CDKN1A"),   logFC = c(1.5, -0.8, 2.1),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) edges <- data.frame(   source      = c("TP53",  "MDM2"),   target      = c("MDM2",  "TP53"),   interaction = c("Activation", "Inhibition"),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE )  # Render the network cytoscapeNetwork(nodes, edges)

title: Network Analysis for MS-based Proteomics Experiments
text: Export network visualization HTML file using exportNetworkToHTML.
code: # Export the network to an HTML file exportNetworkToHTML(nodes, edges, filename = "network.html")

title: Network Analysis for MS-based Proteomics Experiments
text: Use cytoscapeNetworkOutput renderCytoscapeNetwork integrate network visualization Shiny app.
code: library(shiny)  ui <- fluidPage(   cytoscapeNetworkOutput("cytoNetwork") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$cytoNetwork <- renderCytoscapeNetwork({     nodes <- data.frame(       id = c("TP53", "MDM2", "CDKN1A"),       logFC = c(1.5, -0.8, 2.1),       stringsAsFactors = FALSE     )     edges <- data.frame(       source = c("TP53", "MDM2"),       target = c("MDM2", "TP53"),       interaction = c("Activation", "Inhibition"),       stringsAsFactors = FALSE     )     cytoscapeNetwork(nodes, edges)   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

what: Render a Cytoscape network visualisation — cytoscapeNetwork
title: Render a Cytoscape network visualisation — cytoscapeNetwork
text: Creates interactive network diagram powered Cytoscape.js dagre layout algorithm.  Nodes can carry log fold-change (logFC) values mapped blue-grey-red colour gradient.  PTM (post-translational modification) site information shown small satellite nodes edge overlaps surfaced hover tooltips.

title: Render a Cytoscape network visualisation — cytoscapeNetwork
code: cytoscapeNetwork(   nodes,   edges = data.frame(),   displayLabelType = "id",   nodeFontSize = 12,   layoutOptions = NULL,   width = NULL,   height = NULL,   elementId = NULL )

title: Render a Cytoscape network visualisation — cytoscapeNetwork
text: nodes Data frame minimum id column.  Optional columns: logFC (numeric), hgncName (character), Site (character, underscore-separated PTM site list). edges Data frame columns source, target, interaction.  Optional: site, evidenceLink. displayLabelType "id" (default) "hgncName" – controls column used visible node label. nodeFontSize Font size (px) node labels.  Default 12. layoutOptions Named list dagre layout options override defaults (e.g. list(rankDir = "LR")). width, height Widget dimensions passed createWidget. elementId Optional explicit HTML element id.

title: Get subnetwork from INDRA database — getSubnetworkFromIndra
text: Using differential abundance results MSstats, function retrieves subnetwork protein interactions INDRA database.

title: Get subnetwork from INDRA database — getSubnetworkFromIndra
code: getSubnetworkFromIndra(   input,   protein_level_data = NULL,   pvalueCutoff = NULL,   statement_types = NULL,   paper_count_cutoff = 1,   evidence_count_cutoff = 1,   correlation_cutoff = 0.3,   sources_filter = NULL,   logfc_cutoff = NULL,   force_include_other = NULL,   filter_by_curation = FALSE,   filter_by_ptm_site = FALSE,   include_infinite_fc = FALSE,   direction = c("both", "up", "down") )

title: Get subnetwork from INDRA database — getSubnetworkFromIndra
text: input output groupComparison function's comparisionResult table, contains list proteins corresponding p-values, logFCs, along additional HGNC ID HGNC name columns protein_level_data output dataProcess function's ProteinLevelData table, contains list proteins corresponding abundances.  Used annotating correlation information applying correlation cutoffs. pvalueCutoff p-value cutoff filtering. Default NULL, .e. filtering statement_types list interaction types filter .  Equivalent statement type INDRA.  Default NULL. paper_count_cutoff number papers filter . Default 1. evidence_count_cutoff number evidence filter paper. E.g. paper may 5 sentences describing interaction vs 1 sentence.  Default 1. correlation_cutoff protein_level_abundance NULL, apply cutoff edges correlation less specified cutoff.  Default 0.3 sources_filter filtering specific sources.  Default filter, .e. NULL. Otherwise, list, e.g. c('reach', 'medscan'). logfc_cutoff absolute log fold change cutoff filtering proteins. proteins |logFC| greater value retained. Default NULL, .e. logFC filtering. force_include_other character vector identifiers include network, regardless ids input data. formatted "namespace:identifier", e.g. "HGNC:1234" "CHEBI:4911". filter_by_curation logical, whether filter statements curated incorrect INDRA.  Default FALSE. filter_by_ptm_site logical, whether filter edges based whether site information INDRA matches PTM site input.  Default FALSE. applicable differential PTM abundance results. include_infinite_fc logical, whether include proteins infinite log fold change (.e. proteins detected one condition). Default FALSE. direction Character string specifying direction regulation include. One "" (default), "" (upregulated ), "" (downregulated ).
